Niche Miner Dashboard

Ahrefs sweep ki tamam selected keywords — volume, KD, DR<20 sites, page type, tool sites aur notes ke sath. Pehle niche type select karo (Tool ya Info), phir country tab se us country ki rows alag dekho; search, filter aur sort har selection ke andar chalta hai.

Step 3 — My Selected (pasandeeda niches)
Jo niche pasand aye, us ki row ke Select box par ✓ kar do — wo niche yahan My Selected mein copy ho jayegi (asal tab mein bhi rahegi). My Selected ke andar upar wale country tabs se apni pasandeeda niches ko country-wise alag dekh sakte ho. Selections dashboard ke online store mein save hoti hain — jis device ya browser se bhi dashboard kholenge, wohi selections nazar ayengi.
